---
title: "Book a groom"
subtitle: "SOP GRM-10 · Groomer manual"
---

## Purpose

Book a dog in for a future groom with a groomer, on a day and time that
groomer is free.

## Applies to

Every groomer. Anyone may book for any groomer.

## Before you begin

- You are signed in to your profile.

## Procedure

### Open the booking form

1. Open the booking form in one of two ways:
   - **From the dog's card:** open the dog's card (see [GRM-02 Check in a
     dog](checking-in-a-dog.qmd), steps 2 to 4) and click **Book a groom**.
     The Calendar screen opens with the **Book a groom** form, and the dog
     already chosen.
   - **From the Calendar screen:** click **Calendar** at the top of the
     screen, click a day, then click **Book a groom on this day**. Click
     **Which dog?** and type the dog's or owner's name, then click the dog.

   ![The Book a groom form](/screenshots/groomer/booking.png)

### Choose the groom

2. Click **Service** and choose the service, for example **Full groom** or
   **Bath**. The form shows how long it **Takes**, using the usual length for
   that service.
3. If this groom needs a different length (for example, a big matted dog),
   tick **Set a different length for this groom** and click the length, or
   click **All day**.
4. Click **Day** and choose the day.

### Choose the groomer and time

5. Under **Groomer**, click a groomer. Each one shows whether they have
   groomed the dog before and when they are **Free from**. The dog's regular
   groomer is marked **Usual groomer** and is listed first.

   If you choose someone other than the usual groomer, the form asks why. Type
   the reason, for example "Tanya is off, or the owner asked".

6. Under **Start time with** the groomer, click a start time.
7. If useful, click **Note** and type anything the groomer should know, for
   example "owner drops off at 9".

### Save the booking

8. Read the **Book** button. It names the dog, the day, the start and end
   times, and the groomer. If they are right, click it.

## Result

The booking appears on the Calendar screen on the chosen day, and on the
dog's card under the box at the top.

## If something goes wrong

### Paperwork to ask for before the day

The dog's vaccines will have expired by the day of the groom. The booking can
still go ahead. Ask the owner to bring current paperwork. On the day, the
groom cannot start without current rabies paperwork.

### No room that day for this length

The groomer has no free time that day for a groom this long. Choose a shorter
length, another groomer or another day.
